::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [3 May 1879]  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: Eng. lett. d. 495 f106
:::

This is a charming beginning. I shall be delighted to have it next Christmas and <u>if possible</u> will put the chapters in together, so as to have all in one vol.[^1] With many thanks

C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Card printed on one side ‘Foreign post card’ addressed to ‘Italy/ Signora Linda Villari/ 932 Via Pinti/ Florence/Italia’ and postmarked Winchester 3 March 1879.
[^2]: Linda Villari,  'The Angel of Viareggio: A Tale of Child-Life in Italy' began in *MP* ns 31 (January 1880) and ran until July.
